text:
sam: hey team, CI red on my PR #4823 after merging main. pyright is failing with a \"Cannot find name 'ExportedName'\" in gen_bindings, and rustfmt is flagging line-length in src/bindings.rs. I didn't touch those generated files in my diff. local pre-commit passes. Anyone seen an import/jump flake after a rebase?

maria: can you paste the failing log or job link?

sam: here's the short snippets: 
```
pyright --project pyrightconfig.json
/opt/runner/work/repo/repo/python/gen_bindings.py:34: error: Cannot find name 'ExportedName'
```
and rustfmt: 
```
Warning: rustfmt failed on src/bindings.rs: line exceeded 100 chars
```
Local `pre-commit run --all-files` is clean.

ci-bot: CI job 4823-typecheck (pyright) failed — https://ci.example.com/builds/4823/jobs/pyright (logs attached).

olivia: :eyes: could be a change in the codegen tool or pyright/ts/py deps. Did anything in main touch the generator or the proto->py layer? Also are generated files checked in or .gitignored now?

jordan: I can run a bisect if it's intermittent. first try: @sam can you re-run the job (sometimes a transient package mirror or cache) and paste the full pyright log if it fails again?

sam: kicked a rerun: https://ci.example.com/builds/4823/reruns/1 :crossed_fingers:

ci-bot: Rerun queued (pos 2) — will post results.

devops-oncall: quick checklist — check pyright version in the CI image. We bumped it in the base image last week. Run `pipx run pyright --version` locally, and `python -V` to confirm runtime.

maria: fwiw there was a flaky `test_import_resolver` that failed once on Tuesday's nightly. Might be related if resolver handles generated modules. Adding that as a suspect.

olivia: if rerun comes back green, probably a transient. If red again, @jordan and I can bisect main. local suggestion: `git bisect start -- good COMMIT && git bisect run ./scripts/ci_typecheck.sh` to reproduce CI-typecheck state.

sam: rerun finished — still red, same pyright error. Full excerpt: 
```
/opt/runner/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/pyright/langserver.py: info: using config file pyrightconfig.json
/opt/runner/work/repo/repo/python/gen_bindings.py:34:11 - error: Cannot find name 'ExportedName' (reportGeneralTypeIssues)
  34 | class ExportedName(TypedDict):
     |           ^^^^^^^^^^^
  /opt/runner/work/repo/repo/python/other_generated.py: note: exported from generator with comment `# generated`

note: local pre-commit didn't trigger the error — maybe CI is using a different pyright/pylib combo.
```

jordan: starting bisect on main (own runner). will iterate commits until we hit the first bad commit and report back. i'll abort if it only narrows to rustfmt line-length problems (separate).

ci-bot: Bisect started by jordan — testing 14 commits. Logs: https://ci.example.com/bisect/4823

maria: if this points to a pyright bump, we can pin the pyright version in the CI container and open a follow-up to get the pyright team to confirm.

sam: thanks y'all. i'm stepping away for the evening — please ping me on this thread if you find the culprit, i'll follow up in the morning.

olivia: :thumbsup: will update once bisect narrows it down.
